summary_md:
# #456 Äntligen

**Feed**: market-makers  
**Published**: 2026-11-19  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The hosts discuss a risk-off move in AI stocks: Druckenmiller's portfolio changes, the Nvidia/Jensen Huang spy affair and what it means for Nvidia, and a rise in AI-driven cyberattacks hitting Microsoft, Optimizely and WordPress. In Sweden they cover Vusion's bid for Pricer, which they see as possibly blocked by its largest owners, and a turnaround angle at Nordrest via Pizza Hut. They are positive on Embracer's spin-offs, very bearish on Smart Eye after its Q3 cash flow, and constructive on Broadcom and Gravity.

---

## Universe Stocks

### ⛔ SEYE — Smart Eye | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 85%

Q3 cash flow -11 MSEK in the first full quarter with regulation in force; long-term structural decline.

#### Reasoning

2026 was meant to be the harvest year once driver-monitoring rules took effect. Instead the first full quarter under the rules burned cash. Host Mange calls it the nail in the coffin. Self-driving cars will shrink demand for driver monitoring, so even future profits deserve a low multiple. It loses money now and its market declines later.

#### Sell Triggers

- if cash flow turns clearly positive
- if a large OEM volume ramp materialises

> *"Så jag tycker nog snarare att det här är spiken i kistan för bolaget."*

---

### 🟡 PRIC-B — Pricer | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Vusion's 6 SEK bid looks stingy; Sundholm's 10.1% stake can block it, so a higher bid is possible.

#### Reasoning

Even after the premium the bid is about EV/EBIT 7 on 2026, below Sundholm's 7-8 SEK entry price. Other owners with about 10% also find it stingy. Both hosts think the bid could be blocked or raised, and the earnings trend points up. The risk is that the price falls if the bid is withdrawn.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Vusion withdraws the bid
- if Sundholm accepts at 6 SEK

> *"det känns inte helt orimligt att han kommer tacka nej till det här budet"*

---

### 🟢 GRVY — Gravity | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Strong report: revenue +41%, profit +35%; net cash ~95% of market cap; EV/EBIT 0.5; dividend started.

#### Reasoning

The host re-engaged once the dividend made the cash pile worth something to shareholders. Growing both revenue and profit is rare for a mobile game company. The minimum 10% net-profit payout is small but flexible, so there is upside if payouts grow.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the dividend stays token-sized
- if growth reverses

> *"Dessutom kom man med en riktig rökar rapport som var väldigt mycket bättre än jag trodde."*

---

### 🟠 AVGO — Broadcom | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Explosive AI growth, P/E 11 on 2028, PEG 0.3; customer concentration risk.

#### Reasoning

Q3 growth was +86% with free cash flow about half of revenue, and Q4 is guided near +100% with AI above +200%. Earnings are expected to grow fast. The host calls it an interesting supply-chain play on continued AI capex. Risks are dependence on credit-hungry Anthropic and OpenAI, and hyperscalers diversifying suppliers.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI capex slows
- if Anthropic/OpenAI financing dries up
- if forecasts are cut

> *"Men ett intressant play tycker jag ändå i leverantörskedjan"*

---

### 🟠 APP — AppLovin | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Druckenmiller bought; superb report with 80%+ EBITDA margin and buybacks.

#### Reasoning

Revenue rose more than 50% and profit more than 70%, with over 1 bn USD of buybacks and a few billion more authorised. The stock is still down about 30% YTD. Host says 'kanske kan vara någonting att titta på' (maybe worth a look), while noting he may be late, as it is already up 50% in a month.

#### Sell Triggers

- if ad growth stalls

> *"Kanske kan vara någonting att titta på."*

---

### 🟢 NREST — Nordrest | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Host holds a small position; the Pizza Hut deal looks rational given cost control.

#### Reasoning

Host Mange has a small position and finds the setup interesting. He sees management as rational dealmakers with strong cost control who could turn the loss-making Pizza Hut franchise around. He has no deep view on the deal itself.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Pizza Hut turnaround fails
- if dealmaking turns undisciplined

> *"Jag har faktiskt en liten post där nu."*

---

### 🟠 NVDA — Nvidia | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Possible dip buy after Jensen's exit, but circular financing and China restrictions weigh.

#### Reasoning

Hosts ask whether this is a dip-buying moment since everyone is saying no, but argue against it. No successor is likely to be as aggressive as Jensen with customer financing. Receivables have surged, the Remote Access Security Act may restrict China further, and a low backward-looking P/E could be a cyclical trap.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Remote Access Security Act passes
- if Jensen does not return
- if receivables problems escalate

> *"Är det dip-köparläge i... Nvidia. Potentiellt kan det vara det, för alla säger nej just nu."*
